title: Observation
description: One data point in the Legal Rail's normalized store. Every metric — whether a national trend from World Prison Brief, a monthly NHRC figure, or (eventually) a state-level count from CIMS — is expressed as one of these. The dashboard reads only from this shape; it never talks to a source directly.

scope.description: What level this observation describes. CIMS-derived data will mostly be 'state' or 'facility' or 'case'; today's sources are all 'national'.

state.description: Nigerian state name. Null unless scope is 'state', 'facility', or 'case'.

facility.description: Custodial facility name. Null unless scope is 'facility' or 'case'.

case_ref.description: Case Reference Number (CRN), once the rail's identifier exists. Null unless scope is 'case'.

source_id.description: Foreign key into sources.json — which adapter/institution produced this.

fetched_at.description: When this observation was pulled or entered, not when it was published.

confidence_tier.description: 1 = live/automated & sourced & national. 2 = manual entry & sourced. 3 = modeled/estimated. 4 = illustrative/sample only — must never silently promote to a lower number.
